doc: Act I's crowd (M3-CRE-659, ADR 0152): the generic background people who stood as capsules in the greybox zones. One row per person: where they stand (`zone`, the GreyboxZone `stage_actor`), who they are (`role`, `community` and its `island` in bible section 5, `age_band`, `sex`, `build`) and what assets_src/crowd/gen_crowd.py gave them: the crowd `body` they wear (assets/crowd/<body>/), their `tints` (per-instance cloth_a/b/c and hair colours, palette.json swatches or two-swatch mixes) and their `work` clip (crowd_clips.py; empty: idle). `bodies` is the plan the generator samples each body's params from (assets_src/crowd/ranges.json). VillagerLayer resolves a zone row's `crowd: <id>` here. Haluna's own villagers (ch04/haluna_wake's child, fisher, netmender and vendor) keep their M2-CHR-03 bodies and are not in this list. Regenerate with python3 assets_src/crowd/gen_crowd.py (it rewrites body, tints and work).

brine_shoals_wrights.why: act1_ch06 W06 has a dozen wrights kneeling at the waterline; the capsule (0.9 m radius) holds about six, so six crowd people kneel there, each with its own offset in the zone row.

age_tuning.doc: Merged over npc.json's defaults for a crowd person of this age band (FieldNpc.tuning_over), before the work below: a child's quicker turn, shorter pace and restless looking (npc.json's Haluna child row); an elder's slower turn and longer settle (Osu's).

work_tuning.doc: Per crowd work clip (assets_src/crowd/crowd_clips.py): FieldNpc's `work` section (where the head looks while working, node space, and how often it looks up) plus any other tuning the pose needs (a kneeling head is lower). A person's `work` puts {clips.work: <clip>, work: <this>} over its tuning. The children's games (play_stones, play_clap) look at the stones on the ground and at the partner's face 0.6 m off, with quick looks round at passers-by.
